title: Orations Against the Arians
author: athanasius
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: Four orations against the teaching of Arius and his followers. Athanasius argues that the Son is begotten, not made, and that the incarnate life and worship of the church require the full divinity of the Son. The work is also a source for the positions it opposes, quoted at length.
historicalContext: Written during Athanasius's exiles, when the imperial court and several eastern bishops supported Arian or homoean formulas.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the CCEL volume page at read time. Robertson's translation from the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, second series, volume 4, served by the CCEL. Athanasius's Greek is not hosted here.
